content: Anita Sharma called Akanksha Bhatt to address a pending renewal warning caused by a direct debit mismatch on her health policy. Anita sent a secure payment link, Akanksha authorized the ₹4,500 premium, and the policy status was instantly updated to Active. Akanksha received confirmation of the swift resolution and was advised to expect an SMS and updated policy schedule.

action_items: Payment of ₹4,500 completed via secure link
Customer to receive confirmation SMS and updated policy schedule
